title: Work bound for the bounded learner
statement:
Let $n,M\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean target, and let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$. For every output and cost pair in the support of the bounded Kushilevitz–Mansour program run against $f$, the number $w$ of charged local computation steps satisfies
\[
w\leq \frac{2^{42}(n+1)^3(M+1)^8}{\varepsilon^{10}}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean target on the $n$-dimensional cube
